# SubStrUsedAsStrPos

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `SubStrUsedAsStrPosInspection`

Checking a prefix by cutting it out with `substr($s, 0, …)` and comparing the
piece is the long way of asking "does `$s` start with this?". The idiomatic
form is a position search compared strictly against `0`
(`strpos($s, $prefix) === 0`), or its case-insensitive variant when the cut
piece was case-folded first.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,5,6,7,8,9} [Before]
<?php
function routes($uri, $base, $enc) {
    $r = [];
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, strlen($base)) == $base;
    $r[] = '/api' !== substr($uri, 0, 4);
    $r[] = \mb_substr($uri, 0, mb_strlen($base)) === $base;
    $r[] = mb_substr($uri, 0, mb_strlen($base, $enc), $enc) != $base;
    $r[] = mb_strtolower(substr($uri, 0, 4)) === 'get:';
    $r[] = strtoupper(mb_substr($uri, 0, mb_strlen('POST'))) == 'POST';

    $r[] = substr($uri, 1, strlen($base)) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, strpos($uri, '?')) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, 3) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, 5) == '/api';
    $r[] = mb_substr($uri, 0, strlen($base)) == $base;
    $r[] = strtoupper(substr($uri, 0, strlen($base))) == $base;
    $r[] = trim(substr($uri, 0, strlen($base))) == $base;
    $r[] = (substr($uri, 0, strlen($base))) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, strlen($base)) < $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0) == $base;
    return $r;
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function routes($uri, $base, $enc) {
    $r = [];
    $r[] = strpos($uri, $base) === 0;
    $r[] = strpos($uri, '/api') !== 0;
    $r[] = \mb_strpos($uri, $base) === 0;
    $r[] = mb_strpos($uri, $base, 0, $enc) !== 0;
    $r[] = stripos($uri, 'get:') === 0;
    $r[] = mb_stripos($uri, 'POST') === 0;

    $r[] = substr($uri, 1, strlen($base)) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, strpos($uri, '?')) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, 3) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, 5) == '/api';
    $r[] = mb_substr($uri, 0, strlen($base)) == $base;
    $r[] = strtoupper(substr($uri, 0, strlen($base))) == $base;
    $r[] = trim(substr($uri, 0, strlen($base))) == $base;
    $r[] = (substr($uri, 0, strlen($base))) == $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0, strlen($base)) < $base;
    $r[] = substr($uri, 0) == $base;
    return $r;
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;strpos($uri, $base) === 0&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;strpos($uri, &#39;/api&#39;) !== 0&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;\mb_strpos($uri, $base) === 0&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;mb_strpos($uri, $base, 0, $enc) !== 0&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 8: Use &#39;stripos($uri, &#39;get:&#39;) === 0&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 9: Use &#39;mb_stripos($uri, &#39;POST&#39;) === 0&#39; instead.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none) | | | Operand order of the fix follows the global comparison style (`regular` default / `yoda`). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SubStrUsedAsStrPos": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SubStrUsedAsStrPos

/**
 * @noinspection SubStrUsedAsStrPosInspection
 */
```
